verdict.rationale: Orb is a usage-based billing and invoicing platform, not an AI agent or assistant. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role that falls outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Orb shipping any agent or MCP-client feature that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
